nodes.label: Guia de Despliegue de Actualizaciones (Wonka update deployment guide)
Tauri cryptographically-signed auto-update mechanism
nodes.rationale: Tauri app signs releases with TAURI_PRIVATE_KEY/TAURI_KEY_PASSWORD so the splash screen can silently poll a JSON endpoint (version, notes, pub_date, platforms.signature/url) and verify the downloaded .zip/.exe against a .sig signature before installing, preventing anyone else from pushing fake updates and giving a Discord-like silent-update UX.

nodes.label: Railway-hosted backend instead of GitHub Actions for releases
nodes.rationale: Because the backend runs on Railway (Elysia) rather than GitHub Actions, the developer manually builds with `bunx tauri build` and uploads installers/.sig themselves to static hosting (Railway public path, S3, or Cloudflare R2), serving the updater JSON manifest from a Railway route instead of relying on GitHub Releases.
